items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: I've talked about Art Blakely (sic) and about Charlie... I was trying to think about some of the other members of the band...

ctx.x: free, and the saxophone players had a tendency to play just like him. And it just brought about an entirely different kind of a sound. It didn't sound like they were reading at all. I think they recorded Charlie Parker with little groups, with big bands, they recorded him with strings and all of that. But never him playing in section. I think that was a big loss.
I've talked about Art Blakely (sic) and about Charlie... I was trying to think about some of the other members of the band...
